:::{#thm-matmul-distrib}
#### Matrix multiplication is distributive over addition

For an $m \times k$ matrix $\matr{A}$
and $k \times n$ matrices $\matr{B}$ and $\matr{C}$:

$$\matr{A}(\matr{B} + \matr{C}) = \matr{A}\matr{B} + \matr{A}\matr{C}$$

For $m \times k$ matrices $\matr{A}$ and $\matr{B}$
and a $k \times n$ matrix $\matr{C}$:

$$(\matr{A} + \matr{B})\matr{C} = \matr{A}\matr{C} + \matr{B}\matr{C}$$

:::
